AAVSOFilters.description:
Photometric filters a smart telescope may report.

Values are AAVSO filter names. The list is restricted to the filters
such telescopes actually use so that typos and unknown codes are
rejected by the schema.
AAVSOFilters.title: AAVSOFilters

BayerChannels.description:
Channels of a Bayer colour filter array.

A one-shot-colour camera may report a value, such as its gain, per
channel of its Bayer mosaic; such a value is keyed by these names. ``G``
covers both green pixels of an RGGB mosaic.
BayerChannels.title: BayerChannels

StarItem.description: Definition of individual entries in an AAVSO star list.

x.description: X-coordinate of the star center (in pixel coordinates)
x.title: X-coordinate

y.description: Y-coordinate of the star center (in pixel coordinates)
y.title: Y-coordinate

ra.description: Right Ascension of the star (in decimal degrees) at the epoch specified in the metadata
ra.title: Right Ascension

dec.description: Declination of the star (in decimal degrees) at the epoch specified in the metadata
dec.title: Declination

tot_count.description: Total integrated counts of the star, background-subtracted
tot_count.title: Star Count

count_err.description: Error in the total integrated counts of the star
count_err.title: Count Error

bkgd_count.description: Background count level in the vicinity of the star
bkgd_count.title: Background counts

fwhm.description: Full width at half maximum of this star's image, as opposed to the typical value for the whole image in the star list's `fwhm`. None if not available.
fwhm.title: Star FWHM

StarItem.title: StarItem

StarList.description: Definition of the header section of an AAVSO star list schema.

obs_time.description: UTC time at start of observation
obs_time.title: Observation Start Time

site_elev.description: Observer's elevation above mean sea level
site_elev.title: Site Elevation

filter.description: Filter used for the observation, from https://www.aavso.org/filters
filter.title: Filter

block_filter.description: Name of blocking filter used on telescope
block_filter.title: Blocking Filter

width.description: Width of the image in pixels
width.title: Image Width

height.description: Height of the image in pixels
height.title: Image Height

stack.description: Number of images stacked to create this image. If not applicable, set to None.
stack.title: Number of images

adc_depth.description: Bit depth of the analog-to-digital converter
adc_depth.title: A/D Converter Bit Depth

egain.description: Gain of the camera in e-/adu: one value for the whole sensor, or one per Bayer channel of a one-shot-colour camera, keyed by channel (R, G or B). A channel that is left out has no reported gain.
egain.title: System gain

bias.description: Bias (offset) level of this frame in adu: the constant pedestal the camera adds to every pixel, as a zero-second exposure with no light would read, as present in the pixel values the counts in this star list were measured from. Required: a new file should give a number. `null` means the bias was not reported; files upgraded from a schema version before 0.4.0 carry `null`.
bias.title: Bias Level

fwhm.description: Typical full width at half maximum of the stars in this image; each star item may carry its own `fwhm`
fwhm.title: Typical FWHM

photometry_software.description: Software used to produce this photometry, one entry per package, each written as `<name> <version>`. Files upgraded from a schema version before 0.3.0 carry `["unknown"]`.
photometry_software.title: Photometry Software

absolute_focus.description: Absolute focus position of the telescope, in the focuser's native units (typically motor steps), comparable only between images from the same telescope model. None if not available.
absolute_focus.title: Absolute Focus Position

staritems.description: List of stars detected in the image
staritems.title: Star Items

description: Class to hold a list for which each entry is a star list.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema that the file was written against, assigned by AAVSO
schema_version.title: Starlist Schema Version
